summary: Kentucky State Division of Forestry tower in Laurel County, built 1937 and removed in the late 1970s; the site could not be reached and shows no remains in aerial photos.

facts.status_note: Register says the tower was removed in the late 1970s; the former site could not be accessed and online aerial and satellite photos did not reveal anything of the site being left

access.note: Register says the ridge is no longer open to vehicles and the former tower site could not be accessed; no public route is described

visit.trail_note: Register says vehicles can no longer use the ridge access; no trail is described

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Coal Camp Project record's post office address/status field reads 'Operated 1900-1933', but its own Begin Year 1903 and End Year 1925 fields do not match that range. The story reports each one and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Register is the main source. The UK Coal Camp Project record conflicts internally on dates (see resolved_conflicts) and is used only for camp context. Its coordinates (37.208333, -84.070833) differ from the register's (37.198532, -84.071221) by roughly 1 km; the story uses neither. The brief's 'removed 1970' is corrected to 'late 1970s' per the register, and no removed event is recorded because no exact year is given. The 'gone' status rests on the register's account; no photo or site visit report was found.
